title: Device sandbox
summary: Free practice with a wire and a 5F catheter in three test phantoms. No patient, no contrast physics, no scoring.

tipBeyondAccess.note: Catheter tip 20 mm past the sheath tip into the vessel.
Wire tip 10 mm beyond the catheter tip.

hubRotation.note: Tip bend starts facing -x, so the demo has to turn it.

autopilot.description: Advance the wire to 60 mm below the carina, turn the angled tip toward +x, advance into the left daughter, then track the catheter until its tip is 20 mm past the carina.

fluoroTapLength.note: Fluoro is held this long on each tap.

tipAlignTolerance.note: The script waits until the tip's bend direction is this close to +x before advancing.

autopilot.description: Advance wire then catheter through the bend; pull the wire back until its tip is 50 mm behind the catheter tip so the catheter tip re-forms.

catheterPastBend.note: Catheter tip distance beyond the end of the bend.

wireLeadOverCatheter.note: The wire tip stays this far ahead of the catheter tip while both advance.

autopilot.description: Deliberately bad: advance the wire to the cap, then keep pushing to show buckling, the red resistance meter and rumble.

stallSpeed.note: The tip counts as stopped at the cap below this speed.

targetDistance.note: Distance from the access to the farthest phantom target; used by the limit-wire-length rule.
